title: I-81 corridor UFO flaps
place_text: Norfolk/Langley to Winchester, I-81 to Harrisburg PA, DC, Pax River

tellings.quote: towards Pax River. Uh it's called the I81 corridor and they had historically UFO flaps. I hate to call them that for years, decades.

plain: A stretch of Virginia, Maryland and Pennsylvania has had waves of UFO sightings for decades, according to the researcher Dylan Borland. He calls it the I-81 corridor, after the interstate highway, and says it runs from Navy and Air Force country around Norfolk and Langley up past Winchester to Harrisburg, and also takes in Washington DC and Pax River, a Navy flight test base in Maryland. Borland gives no single source but points to the TV series Unsolved Mysteries, and he says he hates to call these sightings "flaps", the word for a burst of reports.
